capabilities.name: Pay by card through an agent
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent pay a merchant with a card network's agent token (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)?

US.note: Visa says Visa Intelligent Commerce is rolled out across a broad set of US agents with live transactions (April 2026), Amex launched its ACE kit and agent purchase protection in April 2026, and Stripe's shared payment tokens can carry Visa, Mastercard and Amex agent tokens. Mastercard planned to enable all US cardholders for Agent Pay by the 2025 holidays but has not said the rollout is done, and no network gives reach numbers.

evidence.title: Mastercard Unveils New Tools and Collaborations to Power Smarter, Safer Agentic Commerce
Mastercard Advances Agentic Commerce With New Trust and Intelligence Services
Visa and Partners Complete Secure AI Transactions, Setting the Stage for Mainstream Adoption in 2026
Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program
American Express Debuts Agentic Commerce Experiences (ACE) Developer Kit and Announces Industry-First Protection for Registered Agent Purchases
Shared payment tokens

GB.note: Visa Intelligent Commerce ran live agent purchases with UK issuers such as Barclays, HSBC UK, Lloyds, NatWest and Nationwide, but only at a few participating merchants such as Frasers and lastminute.com.

evidence.title: Visa and banks across Europe reach the next phase of agentic commerce, unlocking secure access to merchants
Visa partners with European banks and merchants for agentic commerce launch

DE.note: Mastercard Agent Pay completed Germany's first agent purchase with Deutsche Bank, DZ Bank and N26 cards, but only in a closed-loop pilot.

evidence.title: Deutschlands erste agentische Transaktion: Mastercard bringt Agentic Commerce gemeinsam mit Deutsche Bank, DZ Bank und N26 in die Praxis

BR.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Brazil, and Itaú took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions; neither is open to all cardholders.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard advances agentic payments in Latin America and the Caribbean with live transactions completed across the region

MX.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Mexico, and Banamex took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard advances agentic payments in Latin America and the Caribbean with live transactions completed across the region

CL.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Chile, and Banco Falabella and Banco Ripley took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard advances agentic payments in Latin America and the Caribbean with live transactions completed across the region

CO.note: Bancolombia and Davivienda took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions in Latin America, and Bancolombia is testing agent payments with real cards and selected merchants in Visa's Agentic Ready program; Colombia was not in the Santander and Visa pilot, and no Colombian bank offers agent payments to all cardholders.

evidence.title: Mastercard advances agentic payments in Latin America and the Caribbean with live transactions completed across the region
Mastercard unveils Agent Pay in Latin America and the Caribbean
Visa Launches 'Agentic Ready' Program to Advance Agentic Commerce in Latin America & Caribbean

IN.note: Mastercard Agent Pay completed India's first fully authenticated agent purchase in a controlled demo in February 2026, with Axis Bank and RBL Bank cards and the payment aggregators Razorpay, PayU, Juspay and Cashfree.

evidence.title: Mastercard demonstrates readiness for a new era of AI-powered payments in India with its first authenticated agentic commerce transaction
Mastercard brings agentic commerce vision to India

ES.note: Santander and Mastercard Agent Pay ran Europe's first agent purchase with a Santander España card in a controlled setting (March 2026), and Visa Intelligent Commerce lists BBVA, CaixaBank, Bankinter and Abanca among the European issuers in its July 2026 live phase, but only at a few participating merchants.

evidence.title: Santander y Mastercard completan el primer pago real ejecutado por un agente de IA en Europa
Visa and banks across Europe reach the next phase of agentic commerce, unlocking secure access to merchants (issuers include BBVA, CaixaBank, Bankinter, Abanca)

FR.note: Worldline, Crédit Agricole and Mastercard Agent Pay ran France's first agent payment in production in June 2026 (a festival ticket from Weezevent, confirmed by the customer), and Revolut and Visa ran a test agent purchase at Cleverbridge in September 2026. Both are single first transactions, not a launch for all cardholders.

evidence.title: Worldline inaugure le paiement agentique en France avec Crédit Agricole et Mastercard
Revolut annonce avoir réalisé le premier paiement par IA en France
Visa and banks across Europe reach the next phase of agentic commerce, unlocking secure access to merchants (no French issuer named)

CA.note: Visa's Agentic Ready program (May 2026) lets BMO, CIBC, RBC, Scotiabank and TD test agent payments with live cards and real merchants in a controlled setting, and Mastercard Agent Pay ran Canada's first agent purchase with a Rogers Bank card through Flybits in September 2026. Neither is open to all cardholders yet.

evidence.title: Visa Expands 'Agentic Ready' Program to Canada to Advance AI Driven Commerce
Mastercard, Flybits and Rogers establish benchmark for secure, consumer-controlled agentic commerce in Canada

JP.note: Mastercard completed Japan's first live agentic transaction in May 2026 with Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS and other issuers' cards, booking an ELife transfer through an AI agent with Agentic Tokens and Payment Passkeys. Visa's Agentic Ready program has been live in Japan since April 2026 with Credit Saison, MUFG NICOS, Rakuten Card, SB Payment Service and Sumitomo Mitsui Card, but its first phase is an issuer test environment, not a consumer launch.

evidence.title: Mastercard completes first agentic transaction in Japan
Visa Launches 'Agentic Ready' Program in Asia Pacific with Over 50 Partners

AU.note: Mastercard Agent Pay ran Australia's first authenticated agent purchases in January 2026 with a CommBank debit card (Event Cinemas) and a Westpac card, and Visa added Australian partners to its Agentic Ready program in April 2026. We found no general rollout to all cardholders.

evidence.title: Mastercard accelerates AI-powered commerce with Australia's first authenticated agentic transactions using Agent Pay
Visa welcomes partners into Agentic Ready program to unlock agentic commerce

NG.note: No Nigerian bank or card issuer was found in Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay. Visa's Agentic Ready program for Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa (May 2026) names early issuers in the Gulf, Egypt, South Africa and Ukraine, but none in Nigeria, and it is still a testing phase.

evidence.title: Visa Launches "Agentic Ready" Program in CEMEA to Accelerate Agent-Led Commerce

capabilities.name: Pay by instant bank transfer (Pix, UPI)
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent send a payment for you over the country's instant-payment rail?

US.note: No agent payments over FedNow or RTP found; the Fed's April 2026 FedNow proposal is about letting banks use intermediaries, not about agents.

evidence.title: Federal Reserve Board invites public comment on proposal that would allow U.S. banks and credit unions to use intermediaries to transfer funds through the FedNow Service

GB.note: No live agent payment over Faster Payments or VRP found. GoCardless's "first agentic account-to-account payment in the UK" set up a Direct Debit (not Faster Payments) inside the FCA AI Live Testing programme, TrueLayer is only testing agent-started Pay by Bank payments in the FCA sandbox until the end of 2026, and HM Treasury is still consulting on agent payment rules.

evidence.title: TrueLayer selected for FCA's Supercharged Sandbox to test agentic payments
GoCardless processes the first agentic account-to-account payment in the UK
HM Treasury Proposes Major Overhaul of UK Payments Regulation

DE.note: No agent payments over SEPA Instant or Wero found; Wero is live for people in Germany but has no agent feature.

evidence.title: N26 expands instant payment offer with introduction of European digital payment solution Wero

BR.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant makes Pix payments, Nubank's AI assistant sends Pix from text or voice in its app and on WhatsApp, and Iniciador put a Pix agent-payments MCP into production in May 2026; the user confirms each payment.

evidence.title: Mago, seu assistente
Pix por áudio e mensagem: tudo o que você precisa saber
Pix com Inteligência Artificial agora no App e WhatsApp do Nu
Iniciador launches Brazil's first agentic payments MCP on Pix

MX.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant makes transfers in Mexico that the user confirms, and Mercado Pago connects directly to SPEI, but no source says Mago sends money over SPEI, so it stays limited.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanza Mago, su nuevo asistente de IA financiera
Mercado Pago activa Mago: cómo funciona su IA por texto y voz
Mercado Pago se conecta al SPEI

CL.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant arrived in Chile in September 2026 and prepares transfers that the user confirms, but no source says it sends money to other banks over TEF, so it stays limited.

evidence.title: Mago llega a Chile: el asistente personal de Mercado Pago que simplifica el día a día de personas y negocios
Mercado Pago lanzó un asistente con IA para gestionar finanzas y negocios

CO.note: Tpaga launched a WhatsApp AI agent in July 2026 that sends money over Bre-B from text or voice notes. It stays limited because only the press covers it and Tpaga has not said how many users can use it.

evidence.title: Tpaga lanzó el primer agente de inteligencia artificial en Colombia para pagar por PSE
Tpaga lanza primer agente de IA en Colombia para pagos por WhatsApp
Bre-B (pagos inmediatos)

IN.note: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI run a private beta for UPI payments inside ChatGPT using UPI Reserve Pay. MediaNama reports that Amazon Pay launched a consent-based Smart Wallet for agentic UPI payments at GFF 2026, but Amazon Pay has published no details, and NPCI has set no public date for agent payments on UPI.

evidence.title: Razorpay, NPCI, and OpenAI Come Together to Launch Agentic Payments, Ushering in AI-Driven Commerce at National Scale
AI agents can read intent, not approve payments: NPCI chairman at GFF 2026

ES.note: BBVA's Blue assistant sends Bizum, Spain's instant mobile payment, from a typed or spoken request in the BBVA app, and customers made over 400,000 Bizum payments through it in 2022. We found no third-party AI agent that pays over Bizum.

evidence.title: Bizum (pídele un Bizum a Blue por voz o texto)
Blue, el asistente virtual de BBVA, incrementa los pagos por Bizum un 17% en 2022

FR.note: No agent payments over SEPA Instant or Wero found. Wero has been live for people in France since 2024 and is adding shop and recurring payments in 2026, but it has no agent feature.

evidence.title: MPE 2026: five key themes for merchants (agentic commerce; Wero as Europe's own rail)

CA.note: CIBC's Virtual Assistant, a chat bot in CIBC's app and online banking, sends Interac e-Transfers, the everyday way Canadians send money in minutes. That counts the way a bank assistant sending Pix does in Brazil, but e-Transfer is not a true real-time rail, and the new Real-Time Rail is still in participant testing with launch planned for Q4 2026, so this stays limited.

evidence.title: CIBC Virtual Assistant
Real-Time Rail payment system

JP.note: Sumishin SBI Net Bank (renamed DOCOMO SMTB Net Bank in August 2026) has tested its NEOBANK ai agent since February 2026: it makes bank transfers, which run over the Zengin system, from a chat request, but only to registered payees and only for approved beta users at ten branches. It does not yet support Kotra transfers, and we found no other agent that pays over Zengin or Kotra.

evidence.title: NEOBANK ai エージェント(ベータ版)のベータテスト開始について
evidence.publisher: 住信SBIネット銀行 (now DOCOMO SMTB Net Bank)

AU.note: Fintech Vivi Money demonstrated AI-started account-to-account payments over the New Payments Platform by text or voice in June 2026 and said it would launch the next month; we found no confirmation that it is live. No PayTo agent feature was found.

evidence.title: Vivi Money demonstrates AI-initiated A2A payments on Australia's NPP

NG.note: Through Paystack Index (early-access beta), ChatGPT or Claude can send money with Zap, Paystack's app that pays any Nigerian commercial bank account within seconds. Neither Paystack nor the press says the transfers run on NIBSS Instant Payments (NIP), the national instant rail, so this is inferred.

evidence.title: Paystack connects AI and payments
Introducing Zap by Paystack

repos.name: x402
repos.role: Open protocol that revives HTTP 402 so an agent can pay for an API or web page per request with a stablecoin wallet, without an account.

repos.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
repos.role: Open protocol from Google for signed mandates that prove a user let an agent pay, with cards, wallets or stablecoins.

repos.name: Stripe Agent Toolkit
repos.role: Stripe tools and MCP server that let an agent create payment links, invoices, customers and refunds on a Stripe account.

repos.name: mppx (Machine Payments Protocol)
repos.role: TypeScript SDK for the Machine Payments Protocol from Stripe and Tempo, so an agent can pay a service per call from its wallet.

repos.name: Coinbase AgentKit
repos.role: Toolkit that gives an agent its own crypto wallet so it can hold funds, send payments and pay x402 APIs.

repos.name: Hyperswitch
repos.role: Self-hosted payments switch from Juspay that routes payments across many processors and vaults cards, tokens and wallets; a base an agent checkout can run on.

repos.name: Razorpay MCP Server
repos.role: Razorpay's official MCP server, so an agent can create UPI payment links and QR codes, take payments and issue refunds in India.

repos.name: Pix API
repos.role: Brazil central bank's open API spec for Pix, the standard interface any app or agent uses to create and pay Pix charges.

repos.name: MONEI agent skills
repos.role: Official agent skills from MONEI, a Spanish payment institution, that teach coding and shopping agents to take payments by Bizum, Spain's instant mobile payment, and by card, with the customer approving in their bank app.

repos.name: MONEI Node.js SDK
repos.role: Official Node.js client for MONEI, a Spanish payment gateway, so an app or agent can create and track Bizum, card, Apple Pay and Google Pay payments in Spain.

repos.name: PayPay Open Payment API Node SDK
repos.role: Official Node.js SDK for PayPay, Japan's largest QR code wallet, so an app or agent can create payment QR codes, check payments and issue refunds.

repos.name: PayPay Open Payment API Python SDK
repos.role: Official Python SDK for PayPay, so an agent written in Python can take and refund PayPay wallet payments in Japan.

repos.name: Monoova Payments for WooCommerce
repos.role: Monoova's official WooCommerce plugin to take payments over Australia's NPP instant rail with PayID and PayTo mandates, plus cards.

repos.name: Paystack MCP Server
repos.role: Paystack's official MCP server (public preview), which lets an AI agent call the Paystack API to create payments, customers, transfers and refunds for a business in Nigeria.

repos.name: Paystack Node library
repos.role: Official Node.js client for Paystack, Nigeria's main online payment gateway, to start and verify payments and send transfers to Nigerian bank accounts.

repos.name: Flutterwave Node library
repos.role: Official Node.js client for Flutterwave, to collect card, bank transfer and USSD payments, send payouts and pay bills such as airtime and power in Nigeria and across Africa.
